text.tspan: USB computer control; generates STEP/DIR.
Checks PD voltage before enabling the motor.
Internal regulator supplies the 1.1 V core.
2 MB external QSPI flash stores firmware.
Required because RP2040 has no internal flash.
BOOT pads permit ROM USB boot recovery.
12 MHz crystal is the USB clock reference.
Load capacitors and XOUT resistor support
oscillation and limit crystal drive.
USB-C PD sink requests a 15 V motor supply.
PG reports a completed power negotiation.
Efficient 3.3 V supply for MCU and logic.
Diode OR accepts USB data power or PD.
Inductor and capacitors smooth switching.
Two current-regulated bridges drive the coils.
STEP/DIR interface; fixed 1/16 microstepping.
Nominal phase-current limit is 0.351 A.
Clamps ESD on USB D+ and D- at the data port.
VBUS pin references the protection diodes.
PD PORT: motor power, 15 V requested. DATA PORT: USB computer control.
Motor: 14HM11-0404S, bipolar, 0.4 A/phase. Prototype: firmware/bench/rear-fit validation pending.
